title: Woman should bring forth in pain
html_source:
A Patriarchal society is manifested. Women are supposed to experience pain and anguish.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: To the woman he said, I will surely multiply your pain in childbearing; in pain you shall bring forth children.
Genesis 3:16 English Standard Version
